changes.summary: From October 29, 2025, to February 1, 2026, the Musée des Arts Décoratifs presents the photographic work of the artist Guénaëlle de Carbonnières in the “Cabinet des Dessins, Papiers peints et Photographies”. Her work revolves around collective memory, particularly using archaeological and architectural images. For the first time, she immersed herself in the photographic collections of the Musée des Arts Décoratifs to collect and reveal their secrets, like an archaeological dig.
